info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Events Ticketing Tickets Validates-v5-spec
info.description: The Event Ticket Validation API allows event organizers and ticketing service providers to verify the validity of purchased tickets in real-time. By utilizing this endpoint, clients can check whether a ticket is legitimate, enhancing security at event entrances. This functionality is essential for preventing fraud and ensuring a smooth entry process for attendees. Typical users of this API include ticketing platforms, event management software, and venue operators who aim to provide a seamless experience for their customers.

get.description: This endpoint checks the validity of a specified ticket to ensure it is valid for usage. It verifies the ticket details and returns the validation status.

requestBody.description: This request body is required to validate tickets. It should include the necessary details to perform the validation operation. Please ensure that the JSON structure adheres to the specified schema.

200.description: The ticket validation request completed successfully.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsValidatesReque.description: This schema represents the request body for validating operations related to tickets.

status.description: Indicates if the validation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the ticket.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the ticket validation.

state.description: The current state of the ticket after validation.

processingTimeMs.description: The processing time taken for the validation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the validation.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsValidatesRespo.description: Response schema for the ticket validation operation.

createdBy.description: The user who created the ticket validation entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the ticket validation entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the validation process was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Information regarding the audit trail of the ticket validation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time, in milliseconds, taken by the server to process the request.
